data.narrative:
FlyBy Robotics is a Seed-stage defense and security robotics company that has raised $5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies spanning public and private markets—including 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two methodologies triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $5M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies $12M. Peer-median analysis draws on three same-sector comparables at Seed or Series A stage, with a median valuation of $400M across UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The peer range spans $125M to $1.0B. The stage-progression method substantially underweights the peer-based signal, reflecting FlyBy's earlier funding position relative to the comp set.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $11M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $206M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in whether FlyBy will prove comparable to differentiated early-stage players (UFORCE) or more modestly valued Series A entrants (NODA AI). Key variables driving within-range positioning include product maturity, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to named peers.
